about: state-lower contests of 1994 in New Hampshire, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local.py from pipeline/intake/klarner_state_legislative.py's cache.

party_codes.99998: Klarner's codebook (Appendix C): non-major party candidate, but party not specified

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z
klarner.note: compiled by Klarner from official state returns (state election offices' websites when collected, and the earlier ICPSR editions); the origin of each race is not named, and whether a count is before or after a recount is not stated per race
